description: Presidential Secretariat - Appoint Mr.Ravindra Anura Vidanagamage as an Hon. Governer of Uva Province w.e.f. of 06th September 2024.
categorisation: This gazette content solely announces the appointment of a named individual (Mr. Ravindra Anura Vidanagamage) to a government position (Governor of the Uva Province). It does not include any details about the responsibilities, functions, or portfolios associated with the position, making it a clear example of a People Gazette (Type 2).
